common.style: Style/medium: realistic candid documentary event photography, 35mm lens, natural light, slight film grain, true-to-life colors, looks like a real photo taken by a friend at the event.
common.people: People: diverse Southeast Asian (mostly Indonesian) university students and a few lecturers, casual smart clothes, some batik shirts, some hijabs, natural faces and hands, relaxed friendly mood.
common.constraints: Constraints: no readable text anywhere (slides, screens, whiteboards and paper show only abstract shapes, charts or blur), no signage, no logos, no brand names, no watermark, no borders.

shots.alt: A student in a batik shirt presents a bar chart to a full classroom
shots.prompt: Subject: a young woman postgraduate student in a batik shirt presents in front of a projector screen showing an abstract chart with colored bars. About 15 students sit at desks in a bright classroom with big windows, some taking notes on laptops.

shots.alt: Someone in the audience asks a question into a handheld mic
shots.prompt: Subject: question and answer time in a small lecture theater. A male student in the middle rows stands and asks a question holding a wireless handheld microphone, classmates turn to look at him, some smiling. Warm indoor light.

shots.alt: A speaker on a small stage with a laptop at the lectern
shots.prompt: Subject: a PhD student speaks on a low stage in a small campus theater, standing next to a wooden lectern with an open laptop. Audience heads softly out of focus in the foreground. Big screen behind shows an abstract line plot. Warm stage light mixed with cool screen light.

shots.alt: Four students laughing with paper coffee cups by a window
shots.prompt: Subject: after the seminar, four students stand in a bright campus corridor next to big windows holding paper coffee cups, laughing at a story one of them is telling. Late afternoon sun.

shots.alt: Group photo of about twenty attendees in front of the screen
shots.prompt: Subject: a cheerful group photo of about 20 seminar attendees standing and crouching in two rows in front of a projector screen showing a plain white slide, a few doing peace signs, genuine smiles. Classroom setting.

shots.alt: Close-up of hands taking notes next to a laptop
shots.prompt: Subject: close-up of a student's hands writing notes in a paper notebook next to an open laptop that shows a blurry colorful chart, a paper cup of coffee on the desk. Shallow depth of field, soft window light.

shots.alt: A presenter points at a line chart on the screen
shots.prompt: Subject: a male master's student with glasses points at a line chart projected on a screen while explaining, one hand holding a slide clicker. Seen from the side of a classroom, several listeners in the foreground.

shots.alt: Three speakers on stools during a panel discussion
shots.prompt: Subject: a relaxed panel discussion. Three speakers sit on tall stools on a small stage with a moderator holding a microphone, one panelist gestures while talking. Audience partly visible in the foreground.

shots.alt: Undergrads in the back row leaning in to listen
shots.prompt: Subject: undergraduate students in the back row of a classroom lean forward, engaged and curious, one of them smiles and whispers to a friend. The presenter is a blur in the far background.

shots.alt: A volunteer scans a QR ticket on a phone at the door
shots.prompt: Subject: at a small check-in table by a classroom door, a volunteer holds a phone and scans a QR code shown on an arriving student's phone. Name tags and a small plant on the table (tags have no readable text). Friendly smiles.

shots.alt: A student runs the livestream camera at the back of the room
shots.prompt: Subject: at the back of a classroom a student wearing headphones runs a livestream: a camera on a tripod and a laptop with a video mixing interface (blurry, no readable text). The presenter is visible far away at the front.

shots.alt: Snacks and coffee table with students chatting
shots.prompt: Subject: a Friday afternoon snack table with Indonesian traditional cakes (kue) on plates, a big thermos, paper cups, and students chatting while picking snacks. Candid, slightly busy, warm light.

shots.alt: Two students sketch a diagram on a whiteboard
shots.prompt: Subject: two students discuss an idea at a whiteboard, one drawing circles, arrows and boxes with a marker (only shapes, no words), the other thinking with arms crossed and smiling. Classroom after the talk.

shots.alt: A speaker answers a question in a tiered theater
shots.prompt: Subject: a young woman speaker answers a question, gesturing with open hands, seen from behind the audience in a tiered lecture theater. Several raised hands, warm light.

shots.alt: The audience laughing at a joke
shots.prompt: Subject: a candid moment where the whole audience in a classroom laughs at something the presenter said, a few people covering their mouths, genuine joy.

shots.alt: A lecturer gives feedback from the audience
shots.prompt: Subject: an older Indonesian lecturer with gray hair sits in the audience and gives feedback, gesturing, while the young presenter at the front listens and nods. Students around them listen.

shots.alt: Students gather around a laptop after the session
shots.prompt: Subject: after the session, five students crowd around one laptop on a desk, looking at a colorful plot (blurry), one pointing at the screen, others curious and excited.

shots.alt: Wide view of a packed lecture theater from the back
shots.prompt: Subject: wide shot from the back row of a lecture theater with about 60 attendees, a presenter small on stage in front of a big screen showing an abstract network diagram. Rows of heads, soft stage light.

shots.alt: A student in a hijab presents with a clicker
shots.prompt: Subject: a confident young woman in a hijab presents her research with a slide clicker in a compact seminar room, a screen behind her showing an abstract scatter plot, listeners at a long table in the foreground.

shots.alt: A group selfie after the seminar
shots.prompt: Subject: a fun group selfie after the seminar, a student holds the phone up and about eight friends squeeze into the frame, making funny faces, classroom background.

shots.alt: Two students swap contacts with a phone QR code in a hallway
shots.prompt: Subject: two students meet after the seminar in a campus hallway, one shows a contact QR on a phone while the other scans it, both smiling, backpacks, natural light from windows.

shots.alt: Setting up the room before the session
shots.prompt: Subject: before the session starts, one student arranges chairs in an empty classroom while another sets up the projector on a desk, warm afternoon sun through windows, calm quiet moment.

shots.alt: A laptop on the lectern shows online participants
shots.prompt: Subject: hybrid seminar. A laptop on the lectern shows a video call grid of online participants (tiny blurry faces), and the presenter leans in to answer a remote question. Room audience in soft focus.

shots.alt: Students chat by a rainy window with coffee
shots.prompt: Subject: rainy Friday afternoon. Three students sit by a large window with raindrops, holding warm drinks and chatting after the seminar, cozy mood, soft gray daylight.
